_help: Empty input for economic-evaluation. Yearly amounts, in the profile's currency. Keys starting with _ are ignored. "assumption": true marks the whole item; a list marks only those fields. "source": where the number came from or why it was assumed. Spanish keys (ingresos, costos_fijos, supuesto...) are also accepted.
note: net or gross of VAT, today's money or with inflation, what the client pays apart (it goes to the assumptions sheet, marked)
_tax_losses: carry_forward (stand-alone project) · offset (the company has other profits). A plain value without source is marked as an assumption
_salvage_method: market (sold at salvage_value, tax on the gain) · book (at book value)

revenues._or_else: instead of quantity: capacity + occupancy (fraction 0 to 1)
